usageNotes: Use this before applying SDN changes (POST /cluster/sdn) to preview exactly what will change — the diff covers both FRR routing daemon config and the network interfaces file on the specified node. Because SDN config is per-node, run this against each node in the cluster to understand the full blast radius before committing. The caller must hold Sys.Audit on /nodes/{node}; the target node must be online and reachable by the API host.

examples.summary: Preview pending SDN changes on node pve1

tips: Both frr-diff and interfaces-diff are optional in the response; an empty or absent field means no changes are pending for that subsystem.
Run this against every cluster node, not just the local one — SDN zones and VNets may generate different interface diffs per node depending on which bridges/VLANs are active there.
A non-empty frr-diff indicates BGP/EVPN routing changes; review carefully before applying as route flaps can affect VM connectivity.
